items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Pete in the Padres Market. You knew Pete. Sure. Well we played for him.

ctx.x: You know Cock-Eye George? I was trying to make somebody know Cock-Eye George.

Yeah, well that's my first job. He took me on. I was playing the violin. And he took me on a job for the butcher where he used to buy meat. Pete in the Padres Market. You knew Pete. Sure. Well we played for him. He lived around Scott and Canal.
You know, he was a great big white fella.
